items.prompt: I'm hungry. I want to ___ something.
items.explanation: Hungry → you eat. (Thirsty → you drink.)
items.explanationPersian: گرسنه → خوردن. (تشنه → نوشیدن.)

items.prompt: My father's sister is my ___.
items.explanation: Your father's (or mother's) sister is your aunt.
items.explanationPersian: خواهرِ پدر یا مادر، عمه یا خاله است: aunt.

items.prompt: It's cold in here. Please close the ___.
items.explanation: Cold air comes in through an open window.
items.explanationPersian: هوای سرد از پنجره باز می‌آید: window.

items.prompt: We buy food at the ___.
items.explanation: You buy things at a shop.
items.explanationPersian: خرید در فروشگاه انجام می‌شود: shop.

items.prompt: The opposite of 'big' is ___.
items.explanation: big ↔ small.
items.explanationPersian: بزرگ ↔ کوچک: big ↔ small.

items.explanation: Collocation: brush your teeth.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: brush your teeth یعنی مسواک زدن.

items.explanation: Collocation: a cup of coffee/tea.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: a cup of coffee یعنی یک فنجان قهوه.

items.explanation: The day between Tuesday and Thursday is Wednesday.
items.explanationPersian: روز بین سه‌شنبه و پنج‌شنبه (در تقویم انگلیسی): Wednesday.

items.before: At night I sleep in my
items.explanation: You sleep in a bed (in your bedroom).
items.explanationPersian: شب در تخت (bed) یا اتاق‌خواب می‌خوابیم.

items.prompt: What do you call the meal you eat in the morning? (one word)
items.explanation: The morning meal is breakfast.
items.explanationPersian: وعده صبح: breakfast (صبحانه).

items.prompt: What color is the sky on a sunny day? (one word)
items.explanation: On a clear day the sky is blue.
items.explanationPersian: آسمان در روز آفتابی آبی است: blue.

items.explanation: Match each word to its category.
items.explanationPersian: هر کلمه را با دسته‌اش تطبیق بده.

items.prompt: I need to ___ money for my summer holiday.
items.explanation: Keeping money for later = saving it.
items.explanationPersian: نگه داشتن پول برای بعد: save (پس‌انداز کردن).

items.prompt: The train was late, so I ___ the meeting.
items.explanation: You miss a meeting/bus/flight (not 'lose' it).
items.explanationPersian: جا ماندن از جلسه/اتوبوس با miss بیان می‌شود، نه lose.

items.prompt: Can you ___ me a favour?
items.explanation: Fixed collocation: do someone a favour.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: do a favour یعنی لطف کردن.

items.prompt: She ___ her grandmother every weekend.
items.explanation: You visit a person. ('Go' would need 'to': goes to see her.)
items.explanationPersian: دیدار از کسی با visit بیان می‌شود.

items.prompt: I'm really ___ in history.
items.explanation: A person is interested; a thing is interesting.
items.explanationPersian: شخص interested است و چیز interesting.

items.explanation: Collocation: do homework (never 'make').
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: do homework.

items.after: a shower every morning before work.
items.explanation: Both 'take a shower' (AmE) and 'have a shower' (BrE) are correct.
items.explanationPersian: هر دو درست‌اند: take a shower (آمریکایی) و have a shower (بریتانیایی).

items.after: a great time at the party last night.
items.explanation: Collocation: have a good/great time.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: have a great time یعنی خوش گذشتن.

items.before: It's dark in here. Could you turn
items.explanation: Turn on = switch on (lights, TV, ...).
items.explanationPersian: روشن کردن: turn on.

items.prompt: What do you call a person whose job is teaching students? (one word)
items.explanation: A person who teaches is a teacher.
items.explanationPersian: کسی که درس می‌دهد: teacher (معلم).

items.prompt: What do you call the place where you can borrow books? (one word)
items.explanation: You borrow books from a library.
items.explanationPersian: جایی که کتاب امانت می‌گیریم: library (کتابخانه).

items.explanation: Common verb + noun collocations.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب‌های رایج فعل و اسم.

items.prompt: The company decided to ___ the meeting until next week.
items.explanation: 'Until next week' means moving it to a later time: postpone.
items.explanationPersian: به تعویق انداختن تا هفته بعد: postpone.

items.prompt: I completely ___ with your opinion on this.
items.explanation: 'Agree with' someone/an opinion. (Accept/admit take no 'with'.)
items.explanationPersian: موافق بودن با نظر: agree with.

items.prompt: The medicine had no ___ on him at all.
items.explanation: 'Effect' is the noun ('have an effect on'); 'affect' is the verb.
items.explanationPersian: effect اسم است (have an effect on) و affect فعل.

items.prompt: He was ___ of stealing the money.
items.explanation: Accused OF; blamed FOR; charged WITH; arrested FOR.
items.explanationPersian: با of فقط accused می‌آید: accused of یعنی متهم به.

items.prompt: She ___ a very good impression at the interview.
items.explanation: Collocation: make an impression.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: make an impression یعنی تاثیر گذاشتن.

items.after: her mother — same eyes, same laugh.
items.explanation: Take after someone = resemble a family member.
items.explanationPersian: take after یعنی شبیهِ یکی از اعضای خانواده بودن.

items.explanation: Look forward TO + -ing.
items.explanationPersian: ترکیب ثابت: look forward to + ing.

items.after: the job but didn't get it.
items.explanation: Apply FOR a job; apply TO a company.
items.explanationPersian: درخواست دادن برای شغل: apply for.

items.before: It took me two weeks to get
items.explanation: Get over an illness = recover from it.
items.explanationPersian: get over یعنی بهبود یافتن از بیماری.

items.prompt: What is the noun form of the verb 'decide'? (one word)
items.explanation: decide (verb) → decision (noun).
items.explanationPersian: اسمِ فعل decide می‌شود decision (تصمیم).

items.prompt: What do you call a person who travels between home and work every day? (one word)
items.explanation: Someone who commutes daily is a commuter.
items.explanationPersian: کسی که هر روز بین خانه و محل کار رفت‌وآمد می‌کند: commuter.

items.explanation: Match each personality adjective with its meaning.
items.explanationPersian: هر صفت شخصیتی را با معنی‌اش تطبیق بده.

items.prompt: After hours of negotiation, the two sides finally reached a ___.
items.explanation: Reach a compromise = each side accepts less than it wanted.
items.explanationPersian: رسیدن به توافق میانه: reach a compromise (مصالحه).

items.prompt: The new evidence ___ serious doubts about his story.
items.explanation: Raise doubts/questions (transitive). 'Rise' takes no object.
items.explanationPersian: ایجاد تردید: raise doubts؛ فعل rise مفعول نمی‌گیرد.

items.prompt: The project was abandoned ___ lack of funding.
items.explanation: 'Due to' + noun phrase. ('Because' needs a full clause.)
items.explanationPersian: قبل از عبارت اسمی due to می‌آید؛ because جمله کامل می‌خواهد.

items.prompt: She has an excellent ___ of the English language.
items.explanation: Fixed collocation: a (good) command of a language.
items.explanationPersian: تسلط به زبان: command of a language.

items.prompt: The government introduced strict measures to ___ inflation.
items.explanation: Curb = control/limit something harmful (curb inflation, curb spending).
items.explanationPersian: مهار کردن: curb (مثل curb inflation یعنی مهار تورم).

items.explanation: Call off = cancel.
items.explanationPersian: call off یعنی لغو کردن.

items.explanation: An argument that doesn't hold up / hold water fails under examination.
items.explanationPersian: استدلالی که دوام نمی‌آورد: doesn't hold up / doesn't hold water.

items.before: While cleaning the attic, she came
items.explanation: Come across/upon = find by chance.
items.explanationPersian: come across یعنی اتفاقی پیدا کردن.

items.before: After the lawsuit, the company was on the
items.explanation: On the verge/brink/edge of = very close to (usually something bad).
items.explanationPersian: در آستانه چیزی بودن: on the verge/brink of.

items.prompt: What is the adjective form of the noun 'benefit'? (one word)
items.explanation: benefit (noun) → beneficial (adjective).
items.explanationPersian: صفتِ benefit می‌شود beneficial (سودمند).

items.prompt: Which single adjective means 'extremely tired'? (starts with 'ex')
items.explanation: Exhausted = extremely tired.
items.explanationPersian: به‌شدت خسته: exhausted.

items.explanation: Match each formal word with its everyday equivalent.
items.explanationPersian: هر واژه رسمی را با معادل روزمره‌اش تطبیق بده.
